ways.label: Nga Taonga Nature Walk

start.name: clearing beside Graces Stream footbridge
start.quote: the clearing beside Graces Stream footbridge on the downhill side of the car park

evidence: The track begins in the clearing beside Graces Stream footbridge on the downhill side of the car park.
It can also be started further down the valley on the opposite side of the road to the toilets.
If the water is flowing over the ford on the road, park before the ford and use the Nga Taonga Nature Walk to reach the car park.

access_points.name: further down the valley opposite the toilets
access_points.quote: further down the valley on the opposite side of the road to the toilets

doubts: The packet has no road-end features; the start is beside the Graces Stream footbridge, and T1 (Graces Stream, a river) is not clearly that spot, so no ref is given. The text does not say where the walk ends: DOC's time is '45 min one way' and the walk 'can also be started further down the valley on the opposite side of the road to the toilets', which suggests that is the other end (and the walk links the area before the ford to the car park), but this is not stated, so the end is null and that place is recorded as an access point.
